name: sales-call-blueprint-superengine
description: Turns a pre-call DM thread into a customized, psychology-driven sales-call blueprint for coaches and closers. First-run setup + guided tour, then triage (15-min qualification) or strategy (RFPDP closing) blueprints — as a deep Pre-Call Prep doc, a live Call-Time card, or both. Source-agnostic transcript pull (Fathom/Fireflies/Granola/GHL/manual) and pluggable delivery (Google Drive / local / GHL note). Pricing is never stored — you supply it live. Ships a batch agent for prepping many prospects at once.
